comment: Hand edits applied on top of OSM when building the Brisbane pack. `add`: licensed restaurants or other venues OSM misses ({id, name, lon, lat, kind}); ids start with 'manual:'. `include`: OSM ids kept as venues even when their tags don't say they serve alcohol. `exclude`: OSM ids to drop (closed, moved, not really a bar). Include/exclude entries are an id string or {id, note}. The build warns about ids it no longer finds. Per-game curation happens in the lobby.

exclude.note: Blind Tiger Bar, 1b/204 Oxford St, Bulimba: the 2016 address. Blind Tiger is now at 34/1000 Waterworks Rd, The Gap (osm:node/409529625).
